snippet.title: Train Sim World 7 - Free Edition Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Dovetail's latest train sim adds Live Weather, which uses real-time local weather data, along with DirectX 12, DLSS 4.5 and FSR 4. Give the new Free Edition a try today!
